observations.detail: The union context file is not byte-identical to either wave's audited context: it is wave A's post-audit note remediation (e5f7c8daea; 3 notes changed by cbc7082c53 after the wave-A audit) merged with origin/main's 9 wave-B entries. The repository's catalogue-union-parity tool therefore reports ok=false for the context file with 3 pr-side value differences while both catalogues are ok=true. This audit re-read all three notes; they do not change what the ru value must say, and the ru values for those keys are byte-identical to the audited wave-A bytes.

The wave-A INFO about an English AM/PM clock in checkpoint.jump_user is RESOLVED at this head: cbc7082c53 replaced the hand-assembled h:mm AM/PM in checkpointClockLabel with formatTime (locale Intl formatter). Verified by rendering Intl.DateTimeFormat('ru', {hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}) = '15:42' and by reading checkpoint-model.ts at c5e19ecec8.

Suggested «Данные для входа по-прежнему сохранены.» as less calque-like. DECLINED: the catalogue already ships the same English fact as ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.the_sign_in_is_still_saved = 'The sign-in is still saved.' / «Вход всё ещё сохранён.», and the wave-B remediation (RU-WB-N1) chose this construction explicitly to match that sibling. Changing it here would make the two disagree; the sidecar's 'credential is still saved' is satisfied by the saved sign-in, and the sentence never implies the sign-in was lost or expired.

Suggested «без действующего входа» for 'without a working sign-in'. DECLINED: the sidecar defines this arm as 'the sign-in is missing on this machine' and explicitly forbids blaming an expired credential (that is the sibling arm's sentence). «Без входа» states the missing sign-in; «без действующего входа» would imply one exists but does not work, moving this value toward the temporarily-unavailable arm.

observations.detail: Suggested «Поле сообщения» so the landmark name matches the hints. DECLINED: the sidecar defines this as the accessible name of the composer LANDMARK ('the form region the message field lives in'), not of the field; «Поле сообщения» would name the field and under-describe the region. «Ввод сообщения» is a two-word noun phrase as the sidecar's length rule asks, and it is screen-reader only.
